The '''HH780 HotShot barrel''' was a model of [[Augmented spin barrel/Legends|augmented spin barrel]] available during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]]. Produced by the [[Arakyd Industries/Legends|Arakyd Industries]], the attachment could only be used with [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]] or [[Heavy blaster rifle/Legends|heavy blaster rifles]] and was sold for 1750 [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]]. The barrel gave greater damage output and [[Armor/Legends|armor]] penetration but meant the barrel and frame of the weapon were under more stress.<ref name="EOTEC" />

==Behind the scenes==
The HH780 was first mentioned in the [[Star Wars: Edge of the Empire Core Rulebook|''Star Wars: Edge of the Empire'' Core Rulebook]] released by [[Fantasy Flight Games]] in [[2014]].
